title: BountyRush
body:
# 🎯 BountyRush

Bring high-stakes target tracking and assassination contracts to your Paper server with a completely seamless GUI experience! **BountyRush** allows players to set item-backed bounties on their rivals, track targets dynamically, and claim epic rewards upon a successful hunt.

---

### ✨ Features

* **📦 100% GUI-Driven Layout:** No messy command parameters. Select targets, pick rewards straight from your inventory, and view active hits all within beautifully color-coded custom menus.
* **⏳ Flexible Contract Durations:** Creators can choose between **1-hour, 12-hour, or 24-hour** contract limits using an intuitive clock selector interface.
* **🪣 The "Bounty Bucket" Insurance:** If a contract expires without a successful kill, the prize items aren't lost forever! They automatically transfer to the creator's personal Bounty Bucket, where they have **48 hours** to safely reclaim them before they purge.
* **🛑 Anti-Hostage Mechanics:** If an assassin claims a contract and logs off, the contract is automatically freed up so active online hunters can steal the target.
* **💾 Robust Data Storage:** Built-in flat-file auto-saving ensures active bounties, claimed tracking statuses, and bucketed inventory items survive server restarts and crashes flawlessly.

---

### 🎮 Commands

* `/bounty` — Opens the main interface to view active bounties, create a contract, or access your Bounty Bucket.
